name: Yaak
summary: Yaak is a local-first API client for HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket and Server-Sent Events. Its pricing page lists a Business plan at $149 per user a year and an Individual plan at $79 a year. The client is free for personal use, and commercial use needs a license after a 30-day trial.

evidence.capability: send and save HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC requests

facts.text: Yaak describes itself as a local-first API client for HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Yaak imports Postman collections and environments, Insomnia exports, Bruno collections, OpenAPI and Swagger specs, and curl commands.
Yaak says it is free for personal use. Using it at work requires a commercial license after a 30-day trial.
Yaak's pricing page offers licenses billed yearly only. It says there is no monthly billing option.

plans.name: Personal use
plans.notes: Free for personal use according to the Yaak FAQ. Commercial use needs a license after a 30-day trial.

plans.name: Individual (annual)
plans.notes: For one person using Yaak professionally. Billed yearly.

plans.name: Business
plans.unit: per user per year, billed yearly
plans.notes: For teams and organizations. Bulk and enterprise pricing is handled by sales at sales@yaak.app.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page uses dollar signs and does not name a currency.
The page shows no Business lifetime price and no monthly billing option.
The 50% discount for eligible residents is shown only as a coupon, with no resulting price.
